# `Q-24-3` — The Converter Couldn't Read the File

> The converter (pandoc) could not read the file. It may be damaged, password-protected, or a different type than its extension says.

## What this means

The converter exited with an error or produced nothing for this file. The message pandoc gave is shown as the problem text.

## Why this happens

- The file is truncated or damaged (for example, an interrupted download).
- The file is encrypted or password-protected.
- The file's contents are a different type than its extension says.

## How to fix

Open the file in its own application and save a fresh copy, removing any password protection, then import that copy.
